_comment: TS Editor's news feed and update check, read by the What's new panel on the welcome page (libs/ui/widgets/KisWhatsNewWidget.cpp). Edit this file and push to the ts-editor branch; the app picks it up on the next start. Raw github caches for a few minutes. Set latest_version above the running build's version to show the update banner; leave it empty (or at/below the shipped version) for no banner. Write title/text as PLAIN TEXT: the panel escapes them, so an HTML entity here would show up literally.

items.title: Perspective Text: warp lettering onto signs and screens
items.text: A new tool in the toolbox warps text to fit any four corners you click - for text that has to sit on a sign, a can, or a screen. Like Inkscape's object-to-path perspective, it gives true foreshortening, not a flat skew. Type the text in the tool options (with Krita's fast searchable font picker), click the four corners of the surface, and it drops in as a vector shape. More mesh/warp lettering tools are on the way.

items.title: Photoshop design preset rebuilt from a real reference
items.text: The Photoshop preset now matches an actual Photoshop screenshot: sampled palette, flat 1px chrome, a single options bar, a slim tool strip and a collapsible panel rail on the right. Pick it under Settings > Themes.

items.title: TypeR: vertical text and a balloon shape library
items.text: TypeR can set tategaki (columns running top to bottom, right to left) for narrow bubbles and signs, and draw eight balloon shapes — oval, cloud, burst, radio, dashed, robot, wavy and rough — straight into a detected bubble.
